text: Today, we're going to learn about some natural wonders of the world. Can anyone name one?
The Grand Canyon in the USA.
That's correct. It's a massive canyon carved by the Colorado River. What about another one?
Mount Everest. It's the highest mountain in the world.
Yes. And let's not forget the Great Barrier Reef in Australia, the largest coral reef system.
They all sound incredible. I'd love to visit them all.
